label: US fed cattle dressing percentage (comparison figure)
unit: % of live weight remaining as hot carcass (dressing percentage)
basis: majority of US fed cattle; program mean 64% (Mississippi Farm to Feedlot, 1993-2007)

label: USDA Yield Grade closely trimmed boneless retail cuts (%CTBRC)
unit: % of carcass weight as closely trimmed boneless retail cuts, round/loin/rib/chuck only
basis: USDA Yield Grades 5 (<45.4%) through 1 (>52.3%), 1996 grading standard

label: US beef saleable meat (boneless trimmed, share of carcass weight)
unit: % of carcass weight yielded as boneless, trimmed beef
basis: SDSU worked example, 1200 lb steer at 63% dressing; also ~40% of live weight

label: Japanese Black carcass yield (live weight to carcass weight)
unit: % of live weight remaining as carcass weight
basis: at slaughter, 756 kg live / 476 kg carcass, 29.2 months mean age

label: Wagyu finishing period (days on feed)
basis: finishing period, from start of high-energy feeding to slaughter
